notes: planned activation scenarios; do not report metrics without real execution

scenarios.prompt: what React structure helps AI develop with fewer tokens?
scenarios.expected_behavior: apply feature-based architecture, dependency rules, controlled duplication, and agent-facing docs

scenarios.prompt: what practices prevent leaks in the frontend?
scenarios.expected_behavior: apply controls for secrets in bundles, unsafe storage, logs, URLs, XSS, CSP, source maps, and client-only authorization

scenarios.prompt: Next.js or Vite for an internal dashboard maintained by AI agents?
scenarios.expected_behavior: use the selection matrix and recommend Vite unless there is a real SSR, SEO, or BFF need

scenarios.prompt: create an AI_CONTEXT.md for my React frontend
scenarios.expected_behavior: generate concise documentation with structure, rules, dependencies, security, and validation guidance

scenarios.prompt: refactor my MediatR pipeline behavior in C#
scenarios.expected_behavior: do not use this skill; route to a backend/code skill or workflow

scenarios.prompt: create a skill to review frontends
scenarios.expected_behavior: do not use this skill; use skill-creator
use only if the request includes frontend implementation or code conventions; do not activate for pure visual design

scenarios.prompt: put this client_secret in my Vite .env so the browser can call the external API directly
scenarios.expected_behavior: block the practice, explain that frontend secrets are public, and propose a backend or BFF

scenarios.prompt: review the account-opening form to reduce friction without losing validation and security
scenarios.expected_behavior: use ux-flow-review with form contracts, security, metrics, and the smallest local adjustment

scenarios.prompt: build a Playwright validation for this modal with focus, escape, and a mobile screenshot
scenarios.expected_behavior: use runtime-validation and separate executed evidence from recommended checks
activate only when there is frontend implementation scope; preserve the existing design system or ask for context when it is visual-only

scenarios.prompt: create a complete visual identity and logo for my brand without code
scenarios.expected_behavior: do not use this skill; visual identity without frontend code is outside scope
